messages:
sara: Originating RC for today's cut — candidate v2.4.3-rc1. Need quick sign-offs, KV-warm plan, and sheriff for the 16:00 PT promotion window. Pin artifact to v2.4.3-rc1 and include embedding token accounting note. Target promo window 16:00-16:30 PT. @mike you free to sheriff?
ben: Ack. I can take the KV warm. Suggest min-keys=64, parallel=4 to hit warm thresholds quickly. Also recommend canary at 2% for 15m.
mike: I'll be sheriff for the window. Confirmed pinned artifact v2.4.3-rc1. Canary 2% us-west1 first, 15m soak. Abort criteria: >0.5% 5xx or p95 latency >300ms sustained for 3m.
lina: Release notes draft posted: https://go/release/2026-03-21-rc1 — short bullets on embedding cost change, minor tokenizer tweak, and rollback instructions. Added a changelog entry and links to perf dashboards.
sara: Deploy-bot please create the candidate in canary env and provide promote/rollback commands. Also add tag: "rc-originate/2026-03-21" to the artifact.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: candidate created id=rc-20260321-01, artifact_sha=abcdef1234, environment=canary, pinned=true. Commands available: `/promote rc-20260321-01` and `/rollback rc-20260321-01`. See logs at https://deploys.example.com/rc-20260321-01.
ben: Starting KV warm now. Command I'm running: ```bash
./scripts/kv_warm.sh \\ --regions us-west1,us-east1 \\ --min-keys 64 \\ --parallel 4
``` Will update when warmed >=95%.
ben: Update: warmed us-west1=96%, us-east1=91% (still warming). KVs primed for hot paths (chat, embeddings).
ben: KVs at 98% across canary regions. Initiating canary traffic shift to 2%.
mike: Observability on. Watching error budget / p95 / tail latencies. If thresholds breach I'll call abort and request immediate rollback.
sara: Promotion plan: if canary stable for 15m we do staged ramp 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Staging pauses: 5m between ramps, abort on the thresholds above. Rollback command is `deploy-bot /rollback rc-20260321-01` which will pin back previous artifact and drain new pods.
deploy-bot: promote queued: `/promote rc-20260321-01 --staged 2,10,50,100 --pause 5m --auto-verify false`
mike: Ready to execute at 16:00 PT. Authorized to press promote and to abort if needed.
sara: Thanks — proceeding with promote at 16:00 if no further objections. :white_check_mark:
